About.title: Technical notes on this site
About.intro: This page is built with next-intl to properly support Persian and English side by side, with correct routing strategy and automatic text-direction switching (RTL/LTR).
About.how1: Every route lives under [locale] (e.g. /fa and /en), and proxy.ts detects the right language from the URL or browser
About.how2: Text lives in separate message files (messages/fa.json and messages/en.json), not hardcoded inside components
About.how3: Page direction (dir) switches automatically between rtl and ltr, with no manual class needed on each element
About.how4: Most pages stay pure Server Components; only the language switcher is a Client Component since it needs user interaction
